external_primary_pack_validation.supported_selection: default ContainersV1 L0 on source_file/source_package Entity(GraphNodeId), or default EntityV1 L1 on an exact native Entity(GraphNodeId) with the original 27-kind detail-map and source/producer/accepted-record/ownership/evidence joins

external_primary_pack_validation.source_identity: typed GraphEntity identity only; no host filesystem path is passed to Service or resolved by this operation
external_primary_pack_validation.l1_support: exact native ID-ordered local entities and direct edge sequence; callable/Lua/XML/handler roots require an original matching declaration row; missing/incomplete/out-of-neighborhood proof is NotEvaluated, contradictory joined fields are Invalid; unsupported declaration families remain NotEvaluated
external_primary_pack_validation.local_assertion_derivation_chains: recompute derivation record IDs from each record plus its partition ID/digest and close local assertion references within that partition; require complete bounded conflict-free witness closure; missing records/references, conflicts, cycles, incomplete chains, and cross-partition references remain NotEvaluated
external_primary_pack_validation.declaration_identity_rebinding: join declaration origins to original producer assertions and accepted graph records, then deterministically rebind original node IDs to the published graph generation; ownership edges preserve original relation, confidence, and evidence while using published endpoints
external_primary_pack_validation.valid_means: the selected artifact passes the composed structural wire, profile, identity, internal-reference, and supported exact local chain checks; it does not establish native owner closure, producer/catalog authority, source authority, or runtime behavior
external_primary_pack_validation.completed_result: Service operation status complete carries the owner report unchanged; owner state is Valid, Invalid, or NotEvaluated
external_primary_pack_validation.limits: input bytes, complete result-envelope metadata bytes, cumulative context work including Service input hashing, JSON depth, syntactic JSON tokens, and cancellation
external_primary_pack_validation.token_budget: max_tokens counts syntactic JSON scanner tokens, not model tokens
external_primary_pack_validation.acceptance: require a genuine positive StructuralOnly witness and affected-owner Tier S before publication; independent exact-head Quick runs on the published SHA afterward; no PASS asserted; native producer/catalog authority remains NotEvaluated and is not a StructuralOnly positive prerequisite

selected_source_excerpt.refusals: identity or digest mismatch, unsafe or invalid source, cancellation, and work/output budget exhaustion fail conservatively
selected_source_excerpt.rendering: optional distinct JSON and Markdown renderer IDs; Markdown uses SOURCE_METADATA and generated SOURCE_DATA_BEGIN/END around JSON-quoted numbered SRC data lines

all reads bind one exact immutable universe set and never refresh current during a request
user project Blizzard UI source and Reference Pack remain separate universes
exact roots only; search fuzzy ranking and natural-language resolution are outside E3-B
wow-context consumes public typed views and never parses source or accesses raw store or analyzer state
Project Map is a projection and never a second graph
L0 has bounded container structure and L1 has bounded exact entity/local-neighborhood detail
paths remain paths and Possible conflict partial truncated and NotEvaluated remain explicit
every claim has exact origin evidence provenance confidence coverage and conflict closure
every known omitted candidate has a deterministic reason and completeness impact
mandatory identity boundary evidence coverage conflict omission and budget records cannot be pruned

rendering metrics evaluation validation and cache state never enter semantic pack identity
cache keys bind every semantic generation request profile tokenizer privacy boundary and renderer input
no model embedding external tool filesystem network process editor client SQL plugin or source execution in the canonical path
all operations are bounded deterministic cancellable read-only and perform no background continuation
missing implementations probes fixtures benchmarks evaluations and checksums are blocking and never pass
